name: r1104_s_door
hookRule: This door looks fine on the plan. Open it.
script: This door looks fine on the plan. But open it ninety degrees, and it only clears twenty-eight inches.
The ADA needs thirty-two inches of clear width, measured from the face of the door to the stop. Widen the opening four inches, and it passes.
Comment REACH, and I'll send you the free one page cheat sheet with all five.
